run_segment_flow_cli: run the segment_flow script to convert .flo files into segmented flow PNG images by orientation
run_read_flow: run fl.read_flow to load a .flo optical flow file from disk into a numpy array
run_segment_flow: run fl.segment_flow to segment an optical flow array by flow direction orientation
run_save_segmented_png: run Image.fromarray to create a PIL image from a segmented flow numpy array and save as PNG
run_batch_segment_flow: run the segment_flow script to batch process all .flo files in a directory into segmented PNGs
